title: Economy Estimates 1934 - New Furniture, Etc

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5663
Date 31 / 2 / 34

January 26, 34.

Quartermaster.

Economy
Estimates 1934 - New Furniture etc.

With reference to the above the following procedure
will be observed:

1. When requisitions are forwarded you will obtain a
special report from the concerned as to the real
necessity for the particular issue.

2. You will then submit the requisitions to H.Q., for
approval together with the explanatory reports.

It should be noted that all the H.Q., and other
offices in the Administration Building and Divisional
Headquarters will be moved to the new Central Police
Station where all new furniture will be provided, so that
new furniture for these offices during 1934 will only be
approved in cases where it cannot be done without.

〔此处有手写签名〕
P.A.
to Commissioner of Police.

〔左下角有手写批注，字迹潦草难以辨认〕
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
中央与特别班登记处。
编号 D 5663
日期 34年2月31日

34年1月26日。

军需官。

节约
1934年度预算——新家具等。

关于上述事项，将遵循以下程序：

1. 当请购单呈送时，你须向相关人员获取一份特别报告，说明该项配发的实际必要性。

2. 随后，你将请购单连同解释性报告一并提交总部，以待批准。

需注意，行政大楼及各区总部的所有总部办公室和其他办公室将迁至新的中央巡捕房，届时将提供所有新家具，因此，1934年期间，这些办公室的新家具仅在非此不可的情况下方予批准。

〔此处有手写签名〕
助理专员
致警务处处长。

〔左下角有手写批注，字迹潦草难以辨认〕
